newsitem.title: USA: Acordia brokerage unit draws interest.
newsitem.headline: Acordia brokerage unit draws interest.

text.p: Acordia Inc's $335 million property and casualty brokerage business, which went on the block one month ago, has drawn inquiries, a company spokesman told Reuters.

"It is my understanding that Anthem Insurance Cos Inc, through (advisor) Credit Suisse First Boston, has had some inquiries," said Don Stengele, a spokesman for Acordia and Anthem, a mutual insurance company that provides health insurance and holds a 67-percent stake in Acordia.
Stengele did not identify the parties.

Efforts to sell the property and casualty brokerage may gain impetus from ongoing industry consolidation such as Marsh & McLennan Co's agreement this week to acquire Johnson & Higgins for $1.8 billion, analysts said.

"With limited options for growth, brokers are inclined either to purchase earnings streams companies that are valued below their own or companies where they can cut out expenses and realize cost savings," said Conning & Co analyst Jeffrey Thompson.
Analysts most frequently mention Aon Corp; Hilb, Rogal and Hamilton Co; Poe & Brown Inc; Arthur J. Gallagher & Co and even Marsh & McLennan Cos as possible suitors.
NatCity Investments analyst Jeffrey Davis said "any of those could be viable purchasers."
"We're always open to good opportunities," said Marsh & McLennan spokeswoman Barbara Perlmutter, though she declined to comment on rumors.
Aon also said it was contrary to corporate policy to comment on rumors.
The other insurance companies were not immediately available for comment.
Besides the "usual suspects," said Nutmeg Securities analyst Ira Zuckerman, one must also consider two British-based firms with a U.S. presence -- Sedgwick Group Plc and Willis Corroon Group Plc.
Neither were immediately available for comment.

Acordia said its property and casualty business, ranked in July as the nation's seventh largest, has a broad spectrum of clients though it is focused primarily on mid-sized companies. It maintains about 150 offices across the country.
